newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian parliament approves PM's resignation.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian parliament approves PM's resignation.

text.p: Bulgaria's parliament on Saturday approved Prime Minister Zhan Videnov's resignation tendered at a party congress a week ago.
The resignation was accepted by 211 votes with three against and nine abstentions.
Videnov, under fire for his handling of a severe economic crisis, resigned last Saturday, saying he felt he lacked the support he needed to continue as prime minister and party leader.
